guidance: Replace every TODO query before running: tooling trigger-set refuses a set that still contains TODO.
8-10 should_trigger queries with varied phrasing: direct asks, indirect asks, the user's own words, realistic detail (paths, tools, error text).
8-10 should_trigger=false near misses: requests that share keywords or context with {{skill_name}} but belong to another skill or to plain coding.
Each query runs 3 times; a query passes when more than half of its runs behave as labeled; the suite score is the share of passing queries (accept at 0.8).
The split (60% train, 40% validation) is assigned by tooling trigger-set; tune the description on train only, check validation, stop after 5 revisions and add 5-10 fresh queries.
